import scipy as sp
import numpy as np

# All 12 test cases from the bug report
test_cases = [
    {'dfn': 100.0, 'dfd': 0.1, 'nc': 0.1, 'f': 100.0, 'expected': 0.29787396410092676},
    {'dfn': 100.0, 'dfd': 100.0, 'nc': 0.01, 'f': 0.1, 'expected': 4.4344737598690424e-26},
    {'dfn': 100.0, 'dfd': 100.0, 'nc': 0.01, 'f': 0.01, 'expected': 1.8926477420964936e-72},
    {'dfn': 100.0, 'dfd': 0.01, 'nc': 0.1, 'f': 0.01, 'expected': 0.002848616633080384},
    {'dfn': 10.0, 'dfd': 0.01, 'nc': 1.0, 'f': 0.1, 'expected': 0.012339557729057956},
    {'dfn': 1.0, 'dfd': 100.0, 'nc': 100.0, 'f': 0.1, 'expected': 1.7925940526821304e-22},
    {'dfn': 1.0, 'dfd': 0.01, 'nc': 100.0, 'f': 10.0, 'expected': 0.012334711965024968},
    {'dfn': 1.0, 'dfd': 0.01, 'nc': 10.0, 'f': 0.01, 'expected': 0.00021944525290299},
    {'dfn': 10.0, 'dfd': 1.0, 'nc': 0.1, 'f': 100.0, 'expected': 0.9219345555070705},
    {'dfn': 0.1, 'dfd': 0.1, 'nc': 1.0, 'f': 1.0, 'expected': 0.3136335813423239},
    {'dfn': 100.0, 'dfd': 100.0, 'nc': 0.1, 'f': 10.0, 'expected': 1.0},
    {'dfn': 1.0, 'dfd': 0.1, 'nc': 100.0, 'f': 10.0, 'expected': 0.02926064279680897},
]

max_rel_error = 0.0
for i, case in enumerate(test_cases):
    result = sp.special.ncfdtr(case['dfn'], case['dfd'], case['nc'], case['f'])
    probe(f'ncfdtr_result_{i}', result)
    
    expected = case['expected']
    if expected != 0:
        rel_error = abs(result - expected) / abs(expected)
    else:
        rel_error = abs(result - expected)
    probe(f'rel_error_{i}', rel_error)
    max_rel_error = max(max_rel_error, rel_error)

probe('max_rel_error_fixed', max_rel_error)
